files.grove_mauler_bear_v3b.glb: current colour, dire head, dim dark-red eyes, all 11 clips
files.grove_mauler_bear_v3_darkbrown.glb: same mesh, rig and clips; dark brown base colour only

rig: same 29-bone rig as grove_mauler_bear_anim_v2.glb (identical rest pose and inverse bind matrices)

bear_attack_heavy_claw_left.notes: heavy weight-shift onto the right fore, paw raised to about head height, sweeps across the front; left paw replanted by f34, holds to idle

bear_attack_light_claw_right.notes: fast swipe, small body motion; right paw replanted by f19

bear_attack_bite.bleed_note: the bleed effect itself is game-engineer code; this flag is only the design intent
bear_attack_bite.notes: head pulls back, jaw drops, lunge forward and down, jaw snaps shut at f15, short head shake (tear) f15-22, recover to idle

_v3b.dark_brown_variant: swap baseColor image (material grove_mauler_bear_v3b_mat) with grove_mauler_bear_v3b_darkbrown_col.webp (2048x2048, same UVs; loader must decode WebP)

changed_clips.bear_attack_bite: same timing (31 frames, 1.0 s, impact f15, bleed flag) - jaw now opens to 31 deg on the lunge (f8-f14) and snaps shut at f15

_v3b.unchanged_clips: attack, attack2, death, death_old, hit, idle, run, walk, bear_attack_heavy_claw_left, bear_attack_light_claw_right: keyframes identical to v3
